title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 2.1 The Rectangular Coordinate Systems and Graphs: Plot ordered pairs in a Cartesian coordinate system.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 2.1 The Rectangular Coordinate Systems and Graphs: Plot ordered pairs in a Cartesian coordinate system.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "2.1 The Rectangular Coordinate Systems and Graphs", prints these objectives: "Plot ordered pairs in a Cartesian coordinate system." "Graph equations by plotting points." "Graph equations with a graphing utility." "Find x-intercepts and y-intercepts." "Use the distance formula." "Use the midpoint formula.". The section text says: "Tracie set out from Elmhurst, IL, to go to Franklin Park. On the way, she made a few stops to do errands. Each stop is indicated by a red dot in Figure 1 . Laying a rectangular coordinate grid over the map, we can see that each stop aligns with an intersection of grid lines. In this section, we will learn how to use grid lines to describe locations and changes in locations." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
